title: Query contracts
content_data:
Use this endpoint to query contracts. Since commercial contracts are time-sensitive, you will need to specify a date to check the start and end date of valid contracts that cover that date. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/rf/contract/query/|/v1.3/rf/contract/query/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| |New request parameter |/|`rf_campaign_type`| |New response parameter |/|`pulse_start_date`
`pulse_end_date`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/rf/contract/query/ **Method** GET **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable | Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID | | included_date {Required} | string | A certain date within the contract validity, or the start/end time of an ad group. Format: "2020-09-18". | |rf_campaign_type |string| Use this field to specify whether you want to query TikTok Pulse contract. Enum values: `STANDARD` (Reach & Frequency), `PULSE`(TikTok Pulse).

Note: This is an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/rf/contract/query/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&adgroup_ids={{adgroup_ids}}&included_date=2020-09-18' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable | Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | code | number | Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097) | | message | string | Return messages. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097) | | request_id | string | The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | | data | object | Returned data. | #| has_valid_contract | boolean | Whether valid contracts can be found. Enum values: `True`, `False`.

  • The correct contract start date and end date will be returned only when `has_valid_contract` = `True`, which means the specified `included_date` falls within the validity period of the Reach and Frequency contract or TikTok Pulse contract.
  • If `rf_campaign_type` is not set as `PULSE` in the request, `has_valid_contract` is `True`when the specified `included_date` is a date within the Reach and Frequency contract validity period ( `[start_date, end_date]`).
  • If `rf_campaign_type` is set as `PULSE` in the request, `has_valid_contract` is `True`when the specified `included_date` is a date within the TikTok Pulse contract validity period ( `[pulse_start_date, pulse_end_date]`).
| #| pulse_start_date | string | Start date of TikTok Pulse contract. Returned when `rf_campaign_type` is set to `PULSE` in your request.

Note: When you use [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602) to create an R&F campaign and set `rf_campaign_type` to `PULSE`, the schedule delivery time of your ad group (`[schedule_start_time, schedule_end_time]`) must fall on the intersection of `[start_date, end_date]` and `[pulse_start_date, pulse_end_date]` returned in this contract endpoint. | #| pulse_end_date | string | End date of TikTok Pulse contract. Returned when `rf_campaign_type` is set to `PULSE` in your request.

Note: When you use [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602) to create an R&F campaign and set `rf_campaign_type` to `PULSE`, the schedule delivery time of your ad group (`[schedule_start_time, schedule_end_time]`) must fall on the intersection of `[start_date, end_date]` and `[pulse_start_date, pulse_end_date]` returned in this contract endpoint. | #| start_date | string | Start date of Reach and Frequency contract.| #| end_date | string | End date of Reach and Frequency contract. | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "has_valid_contract": true, "start_date": "2020-10-01", "end_date": "2020-11-30" }, "request_id": "1E044AD4"} (/code); ```
